CREATE TABLE cleaned_measurements AS
SELECT 
    session_id,
    participant_id,
    condition,
    cognitive_score,
    reaction_ms,
    recorded_at,
    status,
    notes
FROM measurements
WHERE (
    cognitive_score >= (
        SELECT percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY m2.cognitive_score) AS q1
        FROM measurements m2
    ) 
    AND cognitive_score <= (
        SELECT percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY m2.cognitive_score) AS q3
        FROM measurements m2
    )
    OR
    (Q1 - 1.5 * (Q3 - Q1)) <= cognitive_score AND cognitive_score <= (Q3 + 1.5 * (Q3 - Q1))
))
AND (
    reaction_ms >= (
        SELECT percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY m2.reaction_ms) AS q1
        FROM measurements m2
    )
    AND reaction_ms <= (
        SELECT percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY m2.reaction_ms) AS q3
        FROM measurements m2
    )
    OR
    (Q1 - 1.5 * (Q3 - Q1)) <= reaction_ms AND reaction_ms <= (Q3 + 1.5 * (Q3 - Q1))
))

CREATE TABLE cleaned_measurements AS
WITH stats AS (
    SELECT 
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cognitive_score) AS q1_score,
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cognitive_score) AS q3_score,
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY reaction_ms) AS q1_hour,
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY reaction_ms) AS q3_hour
    FROM measurements
)
SELECT 
    m.session_id,
    m.participant_id,
    m.condition,
    m.cognitive_score,
    m.reaction_ms,
    m.recorded_at,
    m.status,
    m.notes
FROM measurements m, stats s
WHERE 
    (m.cognitive_score >= (s.q1_score - 1.5 * (s.q3_score - s.q1_score)) 
    AND m.cognitive_score <= (s.q3_score + 1.5 * (s.q3_score - s.q1_score)))
    AND
    (m.reaction_ms >= (s.q1_hour - 1.5 * (s.q3_hour - s.q1_hour)) 
    AND m.reaction_ms <= (s.q3_hour + 1.5 * (s.q3_hour - s.q1_hour)))

CREATE TABLE cleaned_measurements AS
SELECT 
    m.session_id,
    m.participant_id,
    m.condition,
    m.cognitive_score,
    m.reaction_ms,
    m.recorded_at,
    m.status,
    m.notes
FROM measurements m
WHERE m.cognitive_score BETWEEN 
    (SELECT AVG(m2.cognitive_score) FROM (SELECT cognitive_score FROM measurements ORDER BY cognitive_score LIMIT 7) m2) 
    AND
    (SELECT AVG(m2.cognitive_score) FROM (SELECT cognitive_score FROM measurements ORDER BY cognitive_score DESC LIMIT 7) m2)
    AND
    m.reaction_ms BETWEEN 
    (SELECT AVG(m2.reaction_ms) FROM (SELECT reaction_ms FROM measurements ORDER BY reaction_ms LIMIT 7) m2) 
    AND
    (SELECT AVG(m2.reaction_ms) FROM (SELECT reaction_ms FROM measurements ORDER BY reaction_ms DESC LIMIT 7) m2)

SELECT COUNT(*), 
       ROUND(MIN(cognitive_score), 2), ROUND(MAX(cognitive_score), 2),
       ROUND(AVG(cognitive_score), 2),
       ROUND(MIN(reaction_ms), 2), ROUND(MAX(reaction_ms), 2),
       ROUND(AVG(reaction_ms), 2)
FROM cleaned_measurements;

SELECT m.session_id, m.participant_id, m.condition, m.cognitive_score, m.reaction_ms
FROM measurements m
LEFT JOIN cleaned_measurements cm ON m.session_id = cm.session_id
WHERE cm.session_id IS NULL
ORDER BY m.cognitive_score, m.reaction_ms;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS cleaned_measurements;
